Gasification conditions: Barley straw pellets, canola hull pellets and oat hull pellets
Feedstock / Temperature / Time / Concent:
• Temperature: 300–500 °C
• Pressure: 22–25 MPa
• Reaction time: 20–60 min
• Biomass/water ratio: 1:5–1:15
• Reactor type: Batch
• Optimized: 500 °C, 60 min and 1:10
Total gas yield (mmol/g):
• High temperature, reaction time and biomass/water ratio were beneficial for total gas yield and H₂ yield from SCWG of canola hull pellets.
• The highest H₂ selectivity and total gas yields of 52% and 7.3 mmol/g were obtained at the optimized condition from SCWG of canola hull pellets.
• SCWG of canola hull pellets demonstrated the highest H₂ and total gas yields.

Gasification conditions: Canola hull, canola meal and canola straw
Feedstock / Temperature / Time / Concent:
• Temperature: 350–500 °C
• Pressure: 23–25 MPa
• Reaction time: 20–80 min
• Feedstock concentration: 10–25 wt%
• Reactor type: Batch
• Optimum: 500 °C, 60 min and 10 wt%
Total gas yield (mmol/g):
• SCWG of canola straw demonstrated the highest H₂ and total gas yields among all the canola residues due to its highest cellulose and hemicellulose contents.
• An increase in temperature and reaction time increased the gaseous yield, however, an increase in feedstock concentration decreased the gas yields.
• The highest H₂ yield and total gas yield of 8.1 mmol/g and 29.7 mmol/g, respectively were obtained at 500 °C, 23–25 MPa, 60 min and 10 wt% feedstock concentration.

Feedstock / Temperature / Time / Concent:
• Temperature: 375–525 °C
• Pressure: 22–25 MPa
• Reaction time: 15–60 min
• Biomass/water ratio: 1:10
• Catalyst: WO₃–TiO₂, KOH, TiO₂, ZrO₂ and WO₃–ZrO₂
• Reactor type: Batch
• Optimum: 525 °C, 1:10 and 60 min
Total gas yield (mmol/g):
• An increase in temperature and reaction time for SCWG of canola meal increased the total gas yields and H₂ yield.
• Co-gasification of canola meal with LDPE demonstrated synergistic behavior on gas yields.
• The highest total gas yield of 17.9 mmol/g and H₂ yield of 8.1 mmol/g were obtained from non-catalytic SCWG at optimal conditions with canola meal and LDPE blending ratio of 1:1.
• In catalytic SCWG, WO₃–TiO₂ improved H₂ yield to 18.5 mmol/g.

• H₂ yield and total gas yields increased from 2.3 mmol/g and 5.2 mmol/g, respectively at 420 °C to 4.9 mmol/g and 12.7 mmol/g at 480 °C.
